widget.name: Data Grid Two Search Bar
widget.description: Search bar for Data grid 2: generates one search control per configured column (attributes and associations) and applies the filters to the linked Data grid 2 data source.

property.caption: Data source
property.description: Data source of the Data grid 2 this search bar filters. Place this widget inside the Data grid 2 Filters placeholder.

property.caption: Search fields
property.description: One entry per search control. Each field filters one column (attribute or association) of the Data grid 2 data source.

property.caption: Caption
property.description: Label shown above the search control.

property.caption: Placeholder
property.description: Placeholder text shown inside the search control.

property.caption: Filter on
property.description: Whether this field filters an attribute or an association of the Data grid 2 data source entity.

property.caption: Control type
property.description: Type of the search control. Text box for free text, combo box for enumeration/boolean or selectable objects, select page to trigger an open page action, date picker for date attributes.

property.caption: Attribute
property.description: Attribute of the Data grid 2 data source entity access via path.

property.caption: Association
property.description: Association of the Data grid 2 data source entity to filter on. Selectable objects come from the Options data source.

property.caption: Options data source
property.description: List of selectable objects shown in the combo box / used by the select page for this association.

property.caption: Option caption attribute
property.description: String attribute of the options data source entity used as the caption of each option.

property.caption: All options caption
property.description: Caption of the 'no filter' entry shown at the top of combo box dropdowns. Defaults to '-- all --'.

property.caption: Options display limit
property.description: Maximum number of options rendered in the combo box dropdown. The end user can type to narrow the list when there are many options.

property.caption: Options parent filter
property.description: Optional association path from the options data source entity to its parent entity. When the search field pointing at the same parent entity has a selection, this field's options are limited to objects linked to that selection (cascading combo boxes).

property.caption: Date format
property.description: Display/input format for Date picker fields, e.g. dd/MM/yyyy. When set, the control becomes a text box following this token pattern (dd, MM, yyyy); otherwise the browser's native date picker is used. Also applies to both From and To inputs of a range search.

property.caption: Search by range
property.description: When enabled, the Date picker shows two inputs — Date from and Date to — and filters records whose date falls within the inclusive range. Either bound may be left empty to search from/until a single date.

property.caption: Select page action
property.description: Action executed when the end user clicks the diagonal-arrow button of this Select page control. Set the action type to 'Open page' and choose the picker page. The page reports the picked object back by dispatching the DOM event 'mx-select-page-pick' with detail { guid } from a JavaScript action called by its pick button — no database writes needed. Falls back to the widget-level Select page action when empty.

property.caption: Fields per row
property.description: Maximum number of search controls shown on one row before the remaining fields wrap onto a new row.

property.caption: Search on button click
property.description: When enabled, typing and selecting only prepares the search locally; the Data grid 2 is filtered only after the end user clicks the Search button. Reset always applies immediately.

property.caption: Select page action
property.description: Default action for every Select page control that does not define its own action. Set the action type to 'Open page' and choose the picker page. The page reports the picked object back by dispatching the DOM event 'mx-select-page-pick' with detail { guid } from a JavaScript action called by its pick button — no database writes needed.

property.caption: Search button caption
property.description: Caption of the search button.

property.caption: Clear button caption
property.description: Caption of the clear button that resets all search fields.

property.caption: Filter button caption
property.description: Caption of the toggle button that shows or hides the search fields.

property.caption: All options caption
property.description: Default caption of the 'no filter' entry shown at the top of combo box dropdowns. Applies to every combo box field that does not define its own 'All options caption'. Defaults to '-- all --'.
